summary: All three routed fixes passed. Full exports reject a missing or broken companion without writing. The legacy fixture and isolated import still work.
nonblocking_findings: A-P3-9 [Nit] review-a: The unchanged daily wrapper does not act on an exporter error. harness/cron-daily.sh:27,803–811 does not stop after the exporter fails. Lines 856–874 check the batch exit, not the export exit. At line 913 the wrapper can stage other docs while the prior benchmark remains. Rationale: The repaired exporter writes nothing on failure. Wrapper error handling predates this phase and is outside its remediation. Send this finding to tech debt.
